home.title: Every crypto asset icon, in one place
home.description: Browse networks, tokens, exchanges, wallets, DApps, and swap providers. Every preview is resolved by CryptoIdentity with optional network badges.
home.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, symbol, network, or provider
home.loadErrorTitle: Unable to load the asset catalog
home.loadErrorDescription: Refresh the page and try again.
home.empty: No assets match the current filters.

usage.title: Install CryptoIdentity
usage.description: Install the complete folder with one command. The component handles networks, tokens, exchanges, wallets, DApps, and swap-provider icons with badges, loading skeletons, and adaptive backgrounds.
usage.anyStackDescription: Native Web, Vue, Svelte, mobile, and server applications can read logoURI from the compressed catalogs without installing the component.
usage.extensionDescription: Wallet and exchange logos may be PNG or SVG. Obtain the complete logoURI before loading it directly or converting its CDN.
usage.catalogDescription: Download and decompress the relevant catalog, match by chain, address, ID, or name, and use logoURI. The component normalizes supported sources to jsDelivr while retaining mirror fallbacks.
usage.directInstallDescription: Install without configuring registries. The default endpoint is cdn.jsdmirror.com.
usage.namedRegistryDescription: When @gmwallet is configured, the install command is shorter.
usage.componentDescription: Pass an icon descriptor; tokens can include a network corner badge.

features.apiDescription: network, token, exchange, wallet, dapp, and swap-provider use the same component.
features.backgroundDescription: Derives a readable surface from each icon in light and dark themes.
features.loadingDescription: Built-in skeletons prevent layout shifts while images load.
features.badgeDescription: cornerIcon can show a token network or another identity.
